summary: Comprehensive functional testing of OpenTicket platform completed. Backend: 31/31 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All key pages load correctly including browse, auth, pricing, contact, terms, privacy, and refunds pages. Auth system with Firebase/Supabase working (Google OAuth + email/password). Role-based sign up (Attendee/Organizer) functional. Protected routes correctly redirect to login. Currency selector with multi-currency support (USD/EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD) working.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthorized requests - minor HTTP status code inconsistency

issues: Name input field not detected by standard selector (may be using custom component)

action_items: No critical issues found - platform is functional
Consider standardizing HTTP status codes (401 vs 403) for unauthorized requests
Previous iteration noted presale_signups table migration needed - verify if applied
Previous iteration noted presale /signup routes returning 404 from public URL - verify if fixed with /subscribe rename
critical_code_review_comments: IDOR protection correctly implemented in eventController.js (lines 132-159, 214-243)
Session expiration (24h) properly enforced in authMiddleware.js
Server-side price validation in stripeController.js (lines 85-155) prevents price manipulation
Multi-currency support with live exchange rate fetching implemented
seed_data_creation: None - no events exist in production database for testing full checkout flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Platform is functionally stable. No public events exist in DB so event view/ticket purchase flow cannot be fully e2e tested without seed data. All API endpoints responding correctly. Frontend loads all pages. Auth flows work (Google OAuth + email/password). Previous presale issues (iteration 53) should be verified - route renamed from /signup to /subscribe to avoid WAF blocking.
